text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Lead 24 to 120 h; mean over events and 5 folds. Upper panels: share of the shift the median follows (smaller is better). Lower panels: share of true readings on the safe side of q95, or q05 for a shift that lowered load (larger is better).'
text.tspan: Lead 24 to 120 h; mean over events and 5 folds.
Upper panels: share of the shift the median follows (smaller is better).
Lower panels: share of true readings on the safe side of q95, or q05 for a shift that lowered load (larger is better).
